req.title: Update pre-populates form
req.statement: The system shall pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-033 requires that GET /<id>/update pre-fills the form with the existing post's title and body. Tests must verify: (1) positive — authenticated author sees correct title and body in the response HTML; (2) negative — unauthenticated user is redirected (cannot see the form); (3) boundary — a post with minimal single-character title and body is correctly pre-populated; (4) negative — a non-author authenticated user gets 403; (5) boundary — a post with maximum-length title/body fields is correctly pre-populated. All tests use exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author
preconditions: Post id=2 exists with title='Pillow delta willow' and body='Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.' authored by user id=1 (Rahul/stone)
expected: Response body contains exact title 'Pillow delta willow'
Response body contains exact body 'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.'
trace: R-FLASKR-033: update form must pre-fill title and body from existing post
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author():
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.get('/2/update')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Pillow delta willow' in r.data
    assert b'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.' in r.data

test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author()

tests.name: test_update_form_prepopulates_exact_title_not_other_post_title
preconditions: Post id=3 authored by Rahul has title 'Bmber matrix orbit'
Post id=2 authored by Rahul has title 'Pillow delta willow'
expected: Response body contains 'Bmber matrix orbit' (post 3 title)

tests.name: test_update_form_prepopulates_after_content_update
preconditions: Post id=2 authored by Rahul exists
actions: POST /2/update with new title='Updated Title' and body='Updated Body'
GET /2/update to verify new values are pre-populated
expected: Response body does NOT contain old title 'Pillow delta willow'
trace: R-FLASKR-033: after a successful update, the form must reflect the NEW values on next GET; STC covers state transition from old to new content
